gallery.filename: OLF Coupeville Display at NAS Whidbey Island 2014-07-19 Open House.JPG
gallery.title: File:OLF Coupeville Display at NAS Whidbey Island 2014-07-19 Open House.JPG
gallery.description:
A NAS Whidbey Island display explaining why the US Navy & NAS Whidbey Island need Naval Outlying Field Coupeville (aka NOLF Coupeville, OLF Coupeville).  
To quote part of the display, "FCLP training involves aircraft flying in patterns to practice touch-and-go landings. ... In order to properly prepare crews for the dynamic nature of shipboard flying, it is imperative to replicate carrier landing experience as much as possible. This includes flying at appropriate altitudes and speeds as well as having practice fields at or near sea level. CVWP aircraft perform FCLPs at both Ault Field and OLF Coupeville.  OLF Coupeville is ideal for this training practice due to its remote location and low ambient lighting. It more closely replicates true landings aboard an aircraft carrier."
